items.title: Remove green waste deposits from municipal land
items.quote: Ich fordere Sie gemäß § 14 OBG NRW auf, die Ablagerungen bis zum 20.01.2026 vollständig zu beseitigen.
items.computation: The authority sets an explicit calendar deadline: 20.01.2026. This date is a Tuesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no weekend/holiday shift under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG NRW is required. Due date stays 20.01.2026.

items.title: File Klage (lawsuit) with the Verwaltungsgericht
items.quote: Die Klage muss binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe des Bescheids schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift des Urkundsbeamten der Geschäftsstelle erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated 23.12.2025, assumed posted the same day (Aufgabe zur Post). Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG NRW a letter sent by post is deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the 3rd day after posting: 23.12.2025 + 3 days = 26.12.2025. That day (2. Weihnachtstag) is a public holiday in NRW, so under § 41 Abs. 2 Satz 4 in conjunction with § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG NRW (analogous application), the fictive Bekanntgabe shifts to the next working day: 27.12. (Sat), 28.12. (Sun) are skipped, giving Bekanntgabe = 29.12.2025 (Monday). The one-month Klage period then runs under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB (via § 57 Abs. 2 VwGO): the day of the event (29.12.2025) is not counted, and the period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same date number, i.e. 29.01.2026. That day is a Thursday and not a NRW public holiday, so no further shift applies. Due date: 29.01.2026.

warnings: The Bekanntgabe (deemed-delivery) calculation assumes the letter was actually posted (Aufgabe zur Post) on its printed date, 23.12.2025; if it was mailed later, the one-month Klage deadline shifts accordingly.

The letter threatens a substitute-execution (Ersatzvornahme) cost of approx. 480,00 € if the removal deadline of 20.01.2026 is missed; this is a contingent cost, not a current invoice, so no separate due date is set for it.
